findings.description: The last available five-view and six-pose preview set still shows angular, irregular clumped overskirt folds and an asymmetric sharply pointed split-front hem. This image set is from the stale V43 build prefix; it does not review the fresh V44 geometry.

The last available sit and crouch images still show large rounded shorts-like thigh shells protruding above and ahead of the overskirt, with narrow front panels leaving anterior thighs visibly uncovered. These are stale V43-prefix images; fresh V44 appearance has not been rendered or reviewed.
The last available full-body back view shows only a small low-contrast waist detail with no readable adjustment-tab function or close-up evidence. This image is from the stale V43 build prefix.

The current source-bound chart proves authored UV coordinates for only three objects. Eighteen active UVMap layers remain provenance-unverified and omitted; four objects report UV not created. No replacement UVs were generated. Complete garment UV acceptance remains blocked.

The V44 trial initially reused a stale V43 build prefix. The corrected V69 run did build and simulate fresh construction, but skin-and-export stopped before producing a fresh render: the pose-constrained apron residual measured 0.036799 m against the unchanged 0.035000 m bound, with 997 orientation-limited vertices. No V44 fresh appearance decision is available.

sourceEvidence.currentPrototypeMotif: The last available appearance images belong to the V43 build prefix and retain visible skirt-form, anterior-coverage, and rear-tab blockers; they are not appearance evidence for fresh V44 geometry. The V44 build and cloth stages completed, but V69 skin-and-export stopped at the pose-constrained apron residual bound before producing fresh renders. UV coverage remains 3/25 source-authored, 18 unverified, 4 not created. Fit, weight acceptance, Shape Keys, Unity/VRChat runtime, package, and release remain unverified.
sourceEvidence.uvMappingStatus: PARTIAL_SOURCE_AUTHORED: 3/25 objects; 18 active layers provenance unverified and omitted; 4 objects UV not created. No automatic or replacement UVs.

nextAction: Resolve the V69 skin-stage residual using a geometry change while preserving its 35 mm residual and triangle-orientation bounds. Resume from the canonical checkpoint, then directly inspect all fresh views and poses; do not reuse the V43-prefix images as V44 appearance evidence.
